Amazon's Prime Air drone delivery service has announced a major expansion of its coverage area today. By the end of 2026, it will reach close to 500 cities across the United States. Here are the next locations set to receive Amazon's drone delivery service.

Amazon Prime Air to reach nearly 500 U.S. cities by end of 2026

Amazon's Prime Air service is expanding rapidly, with plans to reach nearly 500 cities and towns across the United States by the end of 2026 — a sixfold increase from its current footprint — bringing ultra-fast drone delivery to communities serving tens of millions of customers nationwide. Prime Air offers the most diverse selection of drone-delivered items, including millions of groceries, electronics, beauty products, medications, and household essentials, delivered at everyday low prices in as fast as 30 minutes.

Prime Air is currently operational in the following areas:

  • Tolleson, Arizona (Phoenix metropolitan area)
  • Ruskin, Florida (Tampa metropolitan area)
  • Kansas City, Kansas
  • Papillion, Nebraska (Omaha metropolitan area)
  • Baton Rouge, Louisiana
  • Hazel Park, Michigan (Detroit metropolitan area)
  • Pontiac, Michigan (Detroit metropolitan area)
  • Richmond, Texas (Houston metropolitan area)
  • San Antonio, Texas
  • Richardson, Texas (Dallas metropolitan area)
  • Waco, Texas

Drone delivery is set to launch in the following metropolitan areas: Chicago, Illinois; Syracuse, New York; Cleveland, Ohio; Atlanta, Georgia; and Boise, Idaho. Amazon added that "more communities will be added later."

Prime members can enjoy free drone delivery on orders of $50 or more. Orders under $50 incur a $2.99 delivery fee, while non-Prime members pay $4.99 for drone delivery.

Is Amazon's drone delivery service already available in your area? How has your experience been? Let us know in the comments.
